name: cpanel-whm-mcp-server
description: Security-first MCP resource server foundation for cPanel UAPI and WHM API 1

scripts.test: pnpm test:core && pnpm test:passenger-core && pnpm test:preview
scripts.test:core: node scripts/transpile-core.mjs && node --test tests/core.test.mjs tests/auth-policy.test.mjs tests/passenger-config.test.mjs tests/token-claims.test.mjs tests/request-limiter.test.mjs tests/connection-scope.test.mjs tests/mysql-read-repository.test.mjs tests/mysql2-sql-adapter.test.mjs tests/mysql-encrypted-vault.test.mjs
scripts.test:passenger-core: tsc -p tsconfig.passenger-core.json && node scripts/mark-passenger-core.mjs && node --test tests/passenger-core.test.cjs
